fun_facts: Trey McBride was born in Fort Morgan, Colorado.
At Colorado State, Trey McBride won the 2021 Mackey Award, led FBS tight ends with 1,121 receiving yards, and earned first-team All-American honors.
Trey McBride was the first tight end selected in the 2022 NFL Draft.
Trey McBride set the NFL single-season record for a tight end with 126 receptions in 2025.
Trey McBride set an NFL record for most consecutive games with at least five catches by a tight end.

citations.title: Trey McBride Biography - ESPN

excerpts:
They chose his understudy Friday night.

Arizona spent the 55th overall pick on Colorado State standout [Trey McBride](https://www.nfl.com/prospects/trey-mcbride/32004d43-4274-3360-cc50-43990383247d) , making him the first tight end selected in the 2022 NFL Draft in Las Vegas.

McBride brings the hardware with him to the NFL. The 2021 Mackey Award winner led all tight ends in the Football Bowl Subdivision with 1,121 receiving yards and earned first-team All-American honors in his final season with the Rams, capping a career that also included two first-team All-Mountain West selections (2019, 2021). McBride's 1,121 yards were the fourth-most from a tight end in a single season in the FBS since at least 1996.

He certainly earned them. McBride's highlight tape shows off a number of examples of him making contested catches with his strong hands -- he recorded 17 such receptions in 2021, per Pro Football

excerpts:
Arizona Cardinals star [Trey McBride](https://www.nfl.com/players/trey-mcbride) broke the all-time single-season record for receptions by a tight end with 126 and was named the first-team All-Pro TE in 2025, signifying the top player at the position last year.

Despite the record and accolades, the humble McBride told the [Ross Tucker Football Podcast](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GEnKVn8AZ_w) last week that he doesn’t consider himself the best tight end in the game.

“No, I don’t. These guys, [Travis (Kelce)](https://www.nfl.com/players/travis-kelce/) , [George (Kittle)](https://www.nfl
citations.title: Is Trey McBride NFL's top TE? Cardinals All-Pro weighs in | Latest NFL News, Analysis & Updates | NFL.com

excerpts:
On Tuesday, McBride will play in his second straight Pro Bowl, just one of the accolades he received this season, but also a nod to his standing in the NFL -- even if he doesn't see himself in the same way as others do.

McBride turned in the best season of any tight end this season, one that culminated with his first All-Pro nod and included setting two NFL records, including the most consecutive games with five or more catches by a tight end.

And despite all the praise and accomplishments, McBride doesn't think he's the best tight end in the NFL.

"I think I'm a great tight end, I just don't think I'm the best," McBride told ESPN. "I feel like I'm considered one of the top tight ends, but I got to just keep proving myself each and every day, each and every week, every year.
